summary: STAAR Hub iteration 4 (UI/UX refinement pass) verified end-to-end. Backend smoke 3/3 passed (auth demo, coordinate-evening returns 6-action sheet, /guardian/speak cold+warm both 200). P0 fixes VERIFIED: (1) Branded dark #0A0B0E boot loader with 'STAAR HUB' + 'Waking the Guardian…' displays until React hydrates; document.title = 'STAAR Hub | Cross-Life Context Intelligence'; favicon SVG present. (2) Hub header at 390x844 AND 360x740 fully visible — settings-btn right edge = 340px on 360vw (fully inside), subtitle single-line no overflow, portal-node-work bounding box (260, 109, 64x64) inside viewport at 360; also confirmed resize-safe (1280→360 reflow preserved). (3) NO horizontal overflow at /landing, /hub, /work, /settings, /chat, /portal/wellbeing across 360/390/768/1280 widths. P0 A11Y VERIFIED: experience-demo-btn / portal-node-work / settings-btn / talk-guardian-btn / guardian-view-btn / send-btn all render as <BUTTON role='button'>; icon-only controls have aria-labels (settings='Open settings', portals='Open <Name> portal', back='Go back', send='Send message'); Tab+Enter on EXPERIENCE DEMO navigates to /hub via keyboard. Intro persistence: fresh load → /intro; after skip → localStorage.staar_intro_seen='1'; reload lands on /landing. Settings replay-intro-btn present and clickable. Walkthrough: appeared on fresh hub visit at 360x740, walkthrough-next tapped 5 times routed to /work (work-root visible) and staar_tour_done='1' set. Judge E2E: settings scenario-evening-btn → hub → portal-node-work (WORKLOAD HIGH banner) → coordinate-evening-btn → sheet showed 6 SIMULATED pills + testID simulated-note with disclaimer 'DEMO · SIMULATED — no external services, devices or bookings were actually triggered.' → hear-guardian-btn transitioned to 'SPEAKING — TAP TO STOP' → open-guardian-view-btn navigated to /guardian-view showing coordination timeline (Work→Wellbeing/Home, Community→Style/Home/Relationships, Wellbeing→Home/Work) + priorities/decompression/routine/8PM/outfit/departure cards + footer 'Demo mode: coordinated actions are simulated previews of future device & service integrations — nothing external was triggered.'. Chat regression: talk-guardian-btn → chat → suggestion-0 tap returned full GPT-5.6-terra multi-paragraph reply ('Tonight: Rooftop Jazz Night at The Broadview in Toronto, 8:00 PM…') in ~15s; Enter key send worked with 'Just say hi.' → 'Hi.' reply. Settings: helper texts present (autonomy, share/access sections), replay-intro-btn + replay-walkthrough-btn + pause-switch + companion selectors all render. Reload on /hub preserves session (staar_session_token persisted); direct /guardian-view navigation renders when logged in. ONE MINOR ISSUE FOUND: /guardian-view has ~2.5px horizontal overflow at 360 & 390 widths (scrollWidth 392.5 vs clientWidth 360/390) — root cause is the header title/subtitle DIV ('Guardian ViewHOW INTELLIGENCE CONNECTS ACROSS YOUR LIFE') not constrained to viewport (width=318.5, right=392.5). Non-blocking cosmetic bug. Carry-over non-blockers: CanvasKit CDN fetch warns once and falls back to ArrayBuffer; react-native-web 'shadow*' + 'pointerEvents' deprecation console warnings persist.

ui_bugs.issue: ~2.5px horizontal scroll overflow at 360 & 390 viewport widths (sw=392.5, cw=360/390). The <div> wrapping 'Guardian View' + 'HOW INTELLIGENCE CONNECTS ACROSS YOUR LIFE' has right=392.5 (width 318.5) but starts too far left; header row lacks flex:1 + overflow constraint so the long subtitle extends past viewport. Reference: /app/frontend/app/guardian-view.tsx:28-36 (header row, styles.h and styles.sub). Fix: wrap the title/sub View with { flex: 1, minWidth: 0 } and add numberOfLines={1} on the subtitle (or reduce letter-spacing/font-size).

issues: Header subtitle 'HOW INTELLIGENCE CONNECTS ACROSS YOUR LIFE' is long uppercase text that pushes container past viewport by ~3px on mobile widths — visually clipped at right edge on 360/390. All other screens (landing/hub/work/settings/chat/portal/wellbeing) confirmed overflow-free at 360/390/768/1280.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings still present on every render: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/app/hub.tsx primaryBtn (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset), /app/frontend/src/coordination-sheet.tsx cta, hub.tsx Animated.View pointerEvents='none'.

'CanvasKit load failed TypeError: Failed to fetch' followed by 'wasm streaming compile failed... falling back to ArrayBuffer instantiation' still appears on first load. Fallback path renders Skia correctly. Reference: /app/frontend/index.js:72-81.

action_items: Fix /guardian-view mobile header overflow (~3px): in /app/frontend/app/guardian-view.tsx wrap the title/sub View with `{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }` inside the header row and add `numberOfLines={1}` to the subtitle Text. Not urgent — cosmetic only.
(Carry-over, optional) Migrate `shadow*` StyleSheet props → `boxShadow` and `pointerEvents` prop → `style.pointerEvents` in hub.tsx / coordination-sheet.tsx to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
(Carry-over, optional) Self-host /canvaskit.wasm or add retry logic to /app/frontend/index.js to silence CanvasKit CDN fallback warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Boot loader implementation in /app/frontend/index.js is solid: paints #0A0B0E background + brand orb + rotating status text before Skia/JS bundle mounts, and the CSS selector `#root:not(:empty) ~ #boot { display: none }` correctly auto-hides it once React hydrates. Reduced-motion aware. Title + favicon injected before load.

Accessibility pass looks thorough: every Pressable I sampled renders as <BUTTON role='button'> in DOM; icon-only controls (back-btn, settings-btn, send-btn, portal-node-*) have accessibilityLabel. Keyboard Enter on EXPERIENCE DEMO reaches /hub.
Hub radial useWindowDimensions logic (SW*1.02 clamp 430, RADIUS = min(SW*0.4, 168)) keeps all 7 portal nodes inside the viewport on 360→1280 with a live resize (verified after 1280→360 reflow).
Coordination sheet SIMULATED pills + testID simulated-note + 'no external services' disclaimer are consistent with the guardian-view footer disclaimer — good disclosure design for a demo.
Note: request references 'sign-out-btn' testID but the actual button uses testID='logout-btn'; consider aligning naming for future test scripts.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_smoke.py (created — 3 new smoke tests: auth demo, coordinate-evening returns 6-action sheet with id, /guardian/speak cold+warm cache pattern using coordination_id fixture)

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 iter-4 smoke; prior iter-1/2/3 suites untouched and passing)

seed_data_creation: None. POST /api/auth/demo seeds evening-overload user; scenario reset via settings scenario-evening-btn (/api/demo/scenario).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL: https://cross-life-ai.preview.emergentagent.com. Session storage key: 'staar_session_token' in localStorage (persists across reload). Intro persistence key: 'staar_intro_seen'='1'. Walkthrough dismissal key: 'staar_tour_done'='1'. IMPORTANT: each browser_automation invocation is a fresh browser context — localStorage does NOT carry over between calls, so a chat/coord test that directly navigates to /chat or /guardian-view will 401 unless the flow signs in via experience-demo-btn in the same script. Always run login-dependent flows in a single continuous Playwright script. Settings sign-out button testID is 'logout-btn' (not 'sign-out-btn' as review_request suggested). Coordination action cards do not expose per-card 'coord-action-*' testIDs — verify count by counting 'SIMULATED' pill text nodes (6) or the [data-testid="simulated-note"] presence (1).
rca_of_issue: Minor /guardian-view header overflow RCA: In /app/frontend/app/guardian-view.tsx lines 28-36 the header View uses `flexDirection:'row', gap:14, paddingHorizontal:20` but the inner `<View>` containing <Text h> + <Text sub> has no flex:1 or minWidth:0 constraint. The 32px back button + 20px paddingHorizontal + 14px gap = 66px reserved, leaving 324px for text on 390vw. The subtitle 'HOW INTELLIGENCE CONNECTS ACROSS YOUR LIFE' at letterSpacing 1.6 exceeds that on mobile so the container measures 318.5px starting at x=74, extending to right=392.5 — 2.5px past viewport. Reproduction: viewport 390x844, navigate to /guardian-view, run `document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth` → 393. Fix: apply { flex: 1, minWidth: 0 } to that inner View and { numberOfLines: 1 } to the subtitle Text.
